title: without --yes and without a terminal the command shows the diff, refuses (exit 2) and writes nothing
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). The contract runs with no terminal on standard input. `setup instructions` shows the preview on stdout, then exits 2 with `JITSO REJECTED: this changes files: read the preview above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing written` on stderr. No file is created. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: this changes files: read the preview above, then run it again with --yes, or in a terminal to answer the prompt; nothing written
